how: The account's list of scheduled tasks, read from this session (read only). Schedules are in Calgary time (CRON_TZ=America/Edmonton); next_run is as the scheduler reported it, in UTC. Prompts are not copied here.

calgary_insight_tasks.name: Calgary Data Desk: backup morning refresh
calgary_insight_tasks.what_it_does: Starts the Website workflow on main only if no run was started since 4:00 a.m.; changes no file
calgary_insight_tasks.touches_main: starts a build of main; no commit

calgary_insight_tasks.name: Calgary Insight: daily follow-up on dated decisions
calgary_insight_tasks.what_it_does: Records the outcome of watched decisions in ui/accountability/commitments.json
calgary_insight_tasks.touches_main: can commit to main (one data file)

calgary_insight_tasks.name: Calgary Insight: weekly hand check
calgary_insight_tasks.what_it_does: Re-checks the hand-kept lists against their sources
calgary_insight_tasks.touches_main: can commit to main (hand-kept data files, visit.py, web/explore.py)

calgary_insight_tasks.name: Calgary News
calgary_insight_tasks.what_it_does: Publishes the day's edition to the news branch

calgary_insight_tasks.name: CalgaryInsight: Calgary fun fact video (twice daily)
calgary_insight_tasks.what_it_does: Makes and posts a short video

calgary_insight_tasks.name: CalgaryInsight: Calgary news explained (Mon/Wed/Fri)
calgary_insight_tasks.what_it_does: Makes and posts a short video

other_tasks_on_the_account: Two tasks that are not part of Calgary Insight are also listed; both are switched off (since 2026-10-12) and were not changed.
